title: Rheem Furnace Code 10: One-hour ignition lockout
meaning: The furnace entered a one-hour lockout after repeated ignition failures.
commonCauses: A dirty or weak flame sensor
diySteps: Confirm the thermostat is calling for heat and the gas shutoff has not been moved.
Turn furnace power off for five minutes, restore it once, and note whether the same code returns.
whenToCallPro: Call a licensed technician if ignition fails again after one reset or if you smell gas.
snippetAnswer: Rheem furnace code 10 means the furnace entered a one-hour lockout after repeated ignition failures on the supported control family. Confirm the model number and diagnostic chart inside the furnace door before replacing parts.
modelScope: Rheem/Ruud RGFG-family controls using the documented two-digit diagnostic table.

title: Rheem Furnace Code 11: Failed ignition
meaning: The control failed to establish or prove flame during ignition.
commonCauses: A dirty or weak flame sensor
diySteps: Confirm the thermostat is calling for heat and the gas shutoff has not been moved.
Turn furnace power off for five minutes, restore it once, and note whether the same code returns.
whenToCallPro: Call a licensed technician if ignition fails again after one reset or if you smell gas.
snippetAnswer: Rheem furnace code 11 means the control failed to establish or prove flame during ignition on the supported control family. Confirm the model number and diagnostic chart inside the furnace door before replacing parts.
modelScope: Rheem/Ruud RGFG-family controls using the documented two-digit diagnostic table.

title: Rheem Furnace Code 12: Low flame-sensor signal
meaning: The flame-sensor signal is below the acceptable range.
commonCauses: Poor furnace grounding or reversed polarity
Low gas pressure or an unstable burner flame
diySteps: Turn furnace power off and confirm its access panel is fully seated.
Try one reset and note whether the burners light briefly before shutting off.
whenToCallPro: Call a technician if flame drops out again; flame current and combustion should be measured.
snippetAnswer: Rheem furnace code 12 means the flame-sensor signal is below the acceptable range on the supported control family. Confirm the model number and diagnostic chart inside the furnace door before replacing parts.
modelScope: Rheem/Ruud RGFG-family controls using the documented two-digit diagnostic table.

title: Rheem Furnace Code 13: Flame was lost during operation
meaning: The flame signal was lost while the burners were operating.
commonCauses: A dirty or weak flame sensor
Unstable gas pressure or burner flame
diySteps: Confirm the gas shutoff has not been moved and the furnace panel is fully seated.
Try one reset and watch whether the burners light and then shut off again.
whenToCallPro: Call a technician if flame drops out again or ignition becomes delayed or noisy.
snippetAnswer: Rheem furnace code 13 means the flame signal was lost while the burners were operating on the supported control family. Confirm the model number and diagnostic chart inside the furnace door before replacing parts.
modelScope: Rheem/Ruud RGFG-family controls using the documented two-digit diagnostic table.

title: Rheem Furnace Code 14: Flame detected when the gas valve should be off
meaning: The control detected flame when flame should not have been present.
commonCauses: A gas valve leaking or stuck open
whenToCallPro: Turn the furnace off and call a licensed technician immediately to test the gas valve and flame-proving circuit.
dangerNote: Turn the furnace off and do not reset it. If you smell gas, leave the building without operating switches and contact the gas utility or emergency services from outside.
snippetAnswer: Rheem furnace code 14 means the control detected flame when flame should not have been present on the supported control family. Confirm the model number and diagnostic chart inside the furnace door before replacing parts.
modelScope: Rheem/Ruud RGFG-family controls using the documented two-digit diagnostic table.

title: Rheem Furnace Code 21: Pressure Switch Stuck Open
meaning: The pressure switch never closed during inducer operation.
diySteps: Inspect vent and hoses.
Clear condensate trap.
Reset once.
whenToCallPro: Replace failed pressure switch or inducer.
snippetAnswer: Rheem furnace code 21 means pressure switch never closed during inducer operation. Most often from blocked vent. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $175–$900.
modelScope: No universal meaning is confirmed for this code. The exact model number and control-board chart are required.

title: Rheem Furnace Code 22: Limit circuit opened
meaning: The main limit circuit is open.
commonCauses: A dirty or overly restrictive air filter
Closed or blocked supply and return vents
A blower, limit switch, or airflow problem
diySteps: Turn the furnace off and replace a dirty filter with the size and type specified for the system.
Open all supply registers and make sure return grilles are not blocked before trying one reset.
whenToCallPro: Call a technician if the limit code returns; repeated overheating can damage the furnace.
snippetAnswer: Rheem furnace code 22 means the main limit circuit is open on the supported control family. Confirm the model number and diagnostic chart inside the furnace door before replacing parts.
modelScope: Rheem/Ruud RGFG-family controls using the documented two-digit diagnostic table.

title: Rheem Furnace Code 31: Gas Valve Fault
meaning: The control detected a gas valve circuit error.
whenToCallPro: Gas valve faults require licensed repair.
dangerNote: If you smell gas, leave the house and call your gas utility before anything else.
snippetAnswer: Rheem furnace code 31 means control detected a gas valve circuit error. This is an emergency — do not attempt DIY repairs. Call a licensed technician immediately; typical repairs run $350–$900.
modelScope: No universal meaning is confirmed for this code. The exact model number and control-board chart are required.

title: Rheem Furnace Code 33: Manual-reset safety circuit open
meaning: The manual-reset limit control circuit is open.
commonCauses: A blocked flue or combustion-air path
A damaged or restricted heat exchanger
whenToCallPro: Leave the furnace off and call a licensed technician for a combustion-safety inspection.
dangerNote: Keep the furnace off. Do not reset a rollout switch. If you smell gas or a carbon-monoxide alarm sounds, leave the building and contact emergency services or the gas utility.
snippetAnswer: Rheem furnace code 33 means the manual-reset limit control circuit is open on the supported control family. Confirm the model number and diagnostic chart inside the furnace door before replacing parts.
modelScope: Rheem/Ruud RGFG-family controls using the documented two-digit diagnostic table.

title: Rheem Furnace Code 41: Blower Motor Fault
meaning: The blower motor failed to start or tripped on overcurrent.
diySteps: Turn off power.
Check blower wheel for debris.
Verify access panel is closed.
whenToCallPro: Blower motor or capacitor replacement is usually needed.
snippetAnswer: Rheem furnace code 41 means blower motor failed to start or tripped on overcurrent. Most often from failed motor. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $450–$1200.
modelScope: No universal meaning is confirmed for this code. The exact model number and control-board chart are required.

title: Rheem Furnace Code 42: Inducer Motor Fault
meaning: The inducer motor did not operate during venting.
diySteps: Clear vent terminal.
Listen for hum without spin.
Do not force motor.
whenToCallPro: Inducer motor replacement if it will not start.
snippetAnswer: Rheem furnace code 42 means inducer motor did not operate during venting. Most often from seized inducer. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $400–$900.
modelScope: No universal meaning is confirmed for this code. The exact model number and control-board chart are required.

title: Rheem Furnace Code 43: Control Board Fault
meaning: The control board reported an internal error.
diySteps: Turn off power.
Inspect for moisture.
Check condensate drain.
snippetAnswer: Rheem furnace code 43 means control board reported an internal error. Most often from surge damage. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $300–$800.
modelScope: No universal meaning is confirmed for this code. The exact model number and control-board chart are required.

title: Rheem Furnace Code 44: Pressure switch was closed at the wrong time
meaning: A pressure switch was closed when the control expected it to be open.
commonCauses: A pinched or incorrectly connected pressure hose
Shorted pressure-switch wiring or a control fault
diySteps: Turn furnace power off for five minutes and do not bypass or jumper the pressure switch.
Check only the outdoor vent openings for obvious snow, ice, leaves, or nests before restoring power once.
whenToCallPro: Call a technician if the code returns; the switch, hose, wiring, and inducer draft need testing.
snippetAnswer: Rheem furnace code 44 means a pressure switch was closed when the control expected it to be open on the supported control family. Confirm the model number and diagnostic chart inside the furnace door before replacing parts.
modelScope: Rheem/Ruud RGFG-family controls using the documented two-digit diagnostic table.

title: Rheem Furnace Code 45: Pressure-switch circuit did not close
meaning: The low-pressure switch is open when the control expects it to be closed.
commonCauses: A blocked intake or exhaust vent
A restricted condensate drain or pressure hose
A weak inducer motor or pressure switch
diySteps: With the furnace off, check outdoor intake and exhaust openings for snow, ice, leaves, or nests.
Replace a visibly dirty air filter, restore power once, and note whether the code returns.
whenToCallPro: Call a technician if the vent is clear and the pressure-switch code returns; combustion-air testing requires instruments.
snippetAnswer: Rheem furnace code 45 means the low-pressure switch is open when the control expects it to be closed on the supported control family. Confirm the model number and diagnostic chart inside the furnace door before replacing parts.
modelScope: Rheem/Ruud RGFG-family controls using the documented two-digit diagnostic table.

title: Rheem Furnace Code 51: Thermostat Communication Error
meaning: The board lost communication with a smart thermostat.
diySteps: Verify thermostat compatibility.
Reseat wiring.
Power-cycle once.
whenToCallPro: May need thermostat or board replacement.
snippetAnswer: Rheem furnace code 51 means board lost communication with a smart thermostat. Most often from incompatible stat. You can check basics first; professional repairs typically run $100–$400.
modelScope: No universal meaning is confirmed for this code. The exact model number and control-board chart are required.

title: Rheem Furnace Code 61: Blower failed to run
meaning: The indoor blower did not run when commanded.
commonCauses: Loss of power or communication to the blower motor
Damaged motor wiring or an incorrect control configuration
diySteps: Turn furnace power off and replace a visibly dirty filter.
Restore power once and listen for the indoor blower; do not reach into the blower compartment.
whenToCallPro: Call a technician if the blower does not run or the communication fault returns.
snippetAnswer: Rheem furnace code 61 means the indoor blower did not run when commanded on the supported control family. Confirm the model number and diagnostic chart inside the furnace door before replacing parts.
modelScope: Rheem/Ruud RGFG-family controls using the documented two-digit diagnostic table.
